The handwriting was identical to his own, from a letter he’d written as a lovesick teenager and thrown into the sea in 1972.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还裹在灰蓝色的薄雾里，沿街的路灯晕着暖黄的光，把空无一人的柏油路照得发亮。早点摊的蒸汽刚从卷帘门后冒出来，混着隔壁咖啡店飘出的焦香，扫过空荡荡的公交站台。偶尔有晚归的代驾骑着电动车擦过街角，车轮碾过落叶的轻响在安静的街道里格外清晰。远处的摩天楼还亮着几扇加班的窗，像散落在夜色里没来得及收的星子。", "w03": "• Recursion is when you solve a problem by breaking it into smaller, identical versions of the same problem, like peeling open a stack of nested matryoshka dolls.\n• You always need a clear stopping point (called a base case) — that’s when you reach the smallest doll that won’t open any further, so you can stop and start putting everything back.\n• If you forget that stopping point, you’ll keep breaking the problem into tinier pieces forever and never get to the actual answer."}
